Holds one captured 3x3x3 space for a Spatial Projector. Shimmers while full.
Holds one captured 7x7x7 space for a Spatial Projector - a small machine room.
Holds one captured 15x15x15 space for a Spatial Projector - a whole base wing.

Pulls dropped items and XP orbs to you from 6 blocks away while it's on. Sneak + right-click to switch it on or off. Works from your hotbar, needs no power. Items on conveyor belts and near a collecting Drone Station are left alone; sneak to stop pulling for a moment.

Reaches 12 blocks and works from anywhere in your inventory. Runs on FE (charge it in a Charger; a little power per item pulled). Ignore list: hold an item in your off hand and right-click with the magnet to stop pulling it (again to remove it, up to 9 items). Sneak + right-click to switch on or off.

Put elevators above each other in a shaft (up to 32 blocks apart, with two blocks of room above each). Stand on one and jump to go up to the next, or sneak to go down. Right-click with a dye to colour it: elevators only take you to their own colour, so several lifts can share a shaft. Needs no power.

A DHD (Dial Home Device), like on TV: a pedestal with a sloping keypad. Right-click it for the keypad - two rings of glyph keys around a big red dome. Press the six glyphs of an address, then the point of origin (the pyramid), then the dome; the Addresses list types one in for you. A formed (round) gate spins up and locks its chevrons, then the vortex bursts out (anything in front of the gate is vaporised - players are only thrown clear) and the event horizon stays open for 30 seconds - walk through to travel. The gate at the other end lights up too. Press the dome (or Close gate) to shut it early. Redstone: pick an address at the bottom of the keypad, and a redstone signal into the DHD dials it and holds the gate open until the signal goes off. From home every gate costs 50 billion FE to dial plus 1 million FE/t while open, so feed it from an Energy Core (Output Pylons) or a big bank of cables; it holds 100 billion. Each planet is a whole world that generates as you explore. Frost, Dune, Verdant, Inferno, Abyss, Skylands, Mycelia and Crystal Depths are in the address list from the start; eight hidden worlds (Eden, Karoo, Redwood, Murk, Titan, Wraith, Umbra and Void Reach) need their address found first - see Stargate Address. The first visit builds a landing platform with its own gate and DHD, and dialling from a planet is free - Home takes you back to where you left, or go on to another planet. Close gate (or the dome) also shuts an incoming connection opened by the DHD at the other end.
stats: 50 billion FE per gate + 1M FE/t open
30 seconds, or while redstone is on
38 glyphs, 6 + point of origin per address
Frost, Dune, Verdant, Inferno, Abyss, Skylands, Mycelia, Crystal Depths
Eden, Karoo, Redwood, Murk, Titan, Wraith, Umbra, Void Reach

entries.text: A 54-slot chest that moves items between worlds at a quantum level - no Stargate needed. Every Quantum Chest starts as a main chest: put one at your base. Link others to it with a Quantum Linker and anything that goes into a linked chest (by hand, hopper, pipe or machine) appears in the main chest about twice a second, from any distance and any world. Link as many chests as you like to one main chest - e.g. one at each planet's mine. If the main chest's area isn't loaded the items wait in transit (up to 270 stacks) and arrive when it loads. A linked chest only sends while its own area is loaded (you nearby, or a Chunk Loader to keep a remote mine running). Pipes and the storage network can pull from the main chest like any chest. Breaking a main chest drops its contents plus anything in transit, and its linked chests stop sending until linked to a new one. Crafts in pairs.
stats: every 10 ticks, any distance, any world
up to 270 stacks while the main chest isn't loaded
unlimited chests to one main chest

entries.text: Links Quantum Chests. Sneak + right-click your main Quantum Chest to record it (the linker glows), then right-click any number of other Quantum Chests to link them - in this world or another. The linker keeps the main chest, so one trip can link chests on several planets. Sneak + right-click a linked chest to unlink it (it becomes a main chest again).

Build a standing 7x7 square of these (24 blocks, empty inside, facing either way), then right-click any of them with an empty hand: the square turns into a round Stargate like the one on TV - a thick ring with a recessed band of glyphs and nine chevrons. When you dial, the glyph band spins and the chevrons lock one by one before the vortex bursts out of the gate and settles into the rippling event horizon. Don't stand in front of it. Breaking any piece turns it back into blocks. Put a Stargate Dialler within 8 blocks. Once you reach the Inferno planet, 4 Naquadah Ingots and 4 Steel Plates make 8 frames.

An old stone tablet carved with the six glyphs of a hidden world. Eight more worlds lie beyond the first eight - Eden, Karoo, Redwood, Murk, Titan, Wraith, Umbra and Void Reach - but their addresses have to be found. Tablets turn up in chests all over: desert and jungle temples, strongholds, ancient cities, shipwrecks, buried treasure, mansions, bastions, end cities, dungeons, mineshafts, outposts and more - and every planet's landing platform has a supply chest with the address of another hidden world. Right-click to learn it: it joins your DHD's address list. You can also just type its glyphs on the DHD (shown on the tablet); dialling a world teaches you its address too. The tablet isn't used up, so pass it to a friend.
stats: chests in temples, strongholds, ancient cities, shipwrecks, end cities and more

entries.text: Found in the outposts on every planet. Sneak + right-click it to call the planet's guardian - an optional boss with 300 health, heavy armour and a boss bar (a Stray on Frost, a Husk on Dune, a Wither Skeleton on Inferno, a Ravager on Mycelia, an Evoker in the Void Reach and so on). Beat it for a Guardian Heart, Naquadah, diamonds, Mk II upgrades, an address and the planet's own material. Each altar calls one guardian, then goes dark.

Dropped by planet guardians. Not needed for anything - but it's a shortcut: with a Quantum Installer it makes a Naquadah Installer (no planet materials), and with four Speed or Energy Upgrades it makes four Mk II upgrades.

categories.title: Powered tools and gear
categories.intro: Everything here runs on Forge Energy and shows a red charge bar. Charge it in a Charger, a Wireless Charger or a Portable Battery.

entries.text: Mines anything a pickaxe or shovel can, at diamond level. Runs on energy instead of durability - charge it in a Charger, Wireless Charger or Portable Battery. With no charge it barely scratches blocks.
Netherite-level and faster. Shift + right-click in the air to switch between single-block and 3x3 mining.
Cuts anything an axe can, plus leaves and cobwebs. Breaking a log fells the whole tree (up to 128 logs); sneak to cut just one.
Wear it in the chest slot and hold jump to fly. Uses energy only while thrusting, and stops fall damage while it has charge. On a dedicated server, set allow-flight=true in server.properties.
Climbs much faster, holds ten times the energy and gives more protection.
A battery you carry. Right-click to switch it on (it glows): it then charges every other powered item in your inventory and armour - including other mods' tools.
Bigger and much faster Portable Battery.
Charges the powered items carried or worn by every player within 16 blocks. Power it with cables like any machine.
The in-game version of this guide: categories, search, item pages and live recipes read from your game (so modpack changes show up). Every player gets one the first time they join.

Right-click: rotate machines, cycle Battery Box faces, switch Bank Ports, or switch a pipe connection between delivering and pulling. Shift + right-click any Tiered Industries block to pick it up with its items, energy and settings kept.

Makes a machine work faster: +50% speed per card, up to 8 cards (x5). Each one also raises the power use per tick, so pair them with Energy Upgrades. Put them in the machine's Upgrades window - the green arrow button at the top of its screen - or shift-click them in from your inventory.
Goes in a machine's Speed slot and counts as two Speed upgrades - so a full stack of 8 gives 16 (x9 speed). Made from Speed Upgrades, Resonance Crystals and a Naquadah Ingot.
The Energy Upgrade (it used to be called Efficiency): each card cuts a machine's power use by 15%, up to 8 cards (about 73% less). Goes in the machine's Upgrades window next to the Speed cards.

Goes in a machine's Energy slot and counts as two Energy upgrades - a full stack of 8 gives 16 (about -85% power, the most any machine can save). Made from Energy Upgrades, Resonance Crystals and a Naquadah Ingot.

Upgrades a processing machine in place - right-click it with the installer. Advanced machines run 3 operations side by side on the same progress bar, Elite 5, Ultimate 7 and Quantum 9, using power for each one running. Install the tiers in order (Advanced first). Contents, upgrades and settings are kept, and the installers drop back out if you break the machine. Works on the Electric Furnace, Pulverizer, Alloy Smelter, Compressor, Electric Sawmill, Ore Purifier, Rock Crusher, Fluid Mixer and Chemical Washer. The machine's Upgrades window shows its tier. On a Chunk Loader it raises the largest area to 7x7 chunks.
The second machine tier: right-click an Advanced machine to make it Elite (5 operations at once). Made with diamonds. On a Chunk Loader it raises the largest area to 9x9 chunks.
The third machine tier: right-click an Elite machine to make it Ultimate (7 operations at once). Made with netherite. On a Chunk Loader it raises the largest area to 11x11 chunks.
The top machine tier: right-click an Ultimate machine to make it Quantum (9 operations at once). Made with Quantum Alloy. On a Chunk Loader it raises the largest area to 15x15 chunks.
The sixth machine tier: right-click a Quantum machine to make it Naquadah (12 operations at once). A Chunk Loader at Naquadah tier reaches 19x19 chunks.
Silences a machine: right-click any machine with it. To take it off, open the machine's Upgrades window and press Remove. It drops back out if the machine is broken.

Choose exactly where your Quarry digs. Right-click one corner block, then the block at the opposite corner, then right-click the Quarry: it digs that rectangle (up to 65 x 65), from the higher corner's level down to its depth setting. The area can be anywhere - next to the Quarry or across the valley - as long as its chunks are loaded (a Chunk Loader helps). The Quarry's screen shows the planned size; its Centred/Behind button goes back to the normal modes. Sneak + right-click the air to clear the corners.

categories.title: Materials
categories.intro: Ores, ingots, dusts and parts used in recipes.

entries.text: Used in most mid-game recipes. Make it in a blast furnace from iron, or faster in the Alloy Smelter from iron and coal.

Found from Y 24 down to the bottom of the world, most common deep down. Glows faintly. Needs an iron pickaxe. On Stargate planets it also forms richer veins, from deep down up to Y 128, including in netherrack, basalt, sandstone and terracotta.
The deepslate version.
Dropped by uranium ore. Smelt it, or pulverize/purify it for more.
Made into Fuel Rods. Other mods' uranium ingots work too.
Smelts into a uranium ingot.
Fission Reactor fuel. Burns for 5 minutes at up to 800 FE/t.
A spent fuel rod. Pulverize it to get a Uranium Dust back.
entries.obtain: Left behind by the Fission Reactor.

entries.text: Mixed-oxide fuel - uranium with plutonium bred in your reactors. It works in both Fission Reactors and their Fuel Ports, alongside or instead of uranium rods. Each MOX rod lasts twice as long and gives 50% more power, but also 50% more heat, so make sure your cooling keeps up (a Cryo Injector helps). The multiblock burns its MOX rods first. MOX depletes into a normal Depleted Fuel Rod, so the cycle keeps going as long as you add uranium. Made from steel, 2 uranium ingots and 1 plutonium ingot (makes 2).

The second nuclear fuel. Reprocess Depleted Fuel Rods in a Chemical Washer with chlorine and water - each rod gives 1 Plutonium Dust - then smelt the dust into ingots. Used to make MOX Fuel Rods. (If you'd rather get uranium back, the Pulverizer turns a depleted rod into uranium dust instead.)

Found below Y=0. Needs an iron pickaxe; Fortune and Silk Touch work. On Stargate planets it also forms richer veins, from deep down up to Y 128, including in netherrack, basalt, sandstone and terracotta.
The deepslate version - most lithium is found in deepslate.
Dropped by lithium ore. Smelt it, or pulverize/purify it for more.
Needed for Tritium Cells and Superconductor.
Smelts into an iron ingot.
Smelts into a gold ingot.
Smelts into a copper ingot.
Smelts into a lithium ingot.
Made in the Alloy Smelter from copper and lithium. Used for Magnet Coils, Speed Upgrades and top-tier recipes.
The Tier 5 material. Made in the Alloy Smelter from 1 netherite ingot and 4 Superconductor Ingots (makes 2). Used for every Quantum block.
Made in the Compressor. Works with other mods that use plates.
Made in the Compressor.
Made in the Compressor.
Made in the Compressor.
By-product of the Electric Sawmill. Burns as fuel, and 4 compress into paper.
Filled in the Electrolyzer. Fusion reactors hand the empty cells back.
Fusion fuel, made from water in the Electrolyzer.
entries.obtain: Electrolyzer: Empty Fuel Cell + 1,000 mB water.

entries.text: Fusion fuel, made from lithium in the Electrolyzer.

entries.text: Found only on the Frost planet, in ice, snow and stone. Drops 2-4 Cryonite Shards (more with Fortune).
Glowing ice crystal from the Frost planet. Nine make a Block of Cryonite; also used in the Aether Stabilizer Module.
Put it inside a multiblock Fission Reactor: it counts as three Coolant Channels.
Golden, faintly glowing sand found only on the Dune planet. Smelt it into Solar Glass.
Glowing golden glass made from Solarite Sand. The top of the Stellar Solar Panel.
Wood from the Livingwood trees that grow only on the Verdant planet. Craft one with 4 bone meal for 16 Fertilizer, or into planks.
Planks from Livingwood - green, for building.
The rare metal of the Inferno planet, in netherrack, basalt and blackstone. Needs a diamond pickaxe. Drops Raw Naquadah; doubles in the Pulverizer, triples in the Ore Purifier like any ore.
Smelt into Naquadah Ingots, or process it for more.
Smelts into a Naquadah Ingot.
The planet metal: makes the Naquadah Installer (a sixth machine tier), Mk II upgrades, the Stellar Solar Panel and cheap Stargate Frames (8 from 4 ingots and 4 steel plates).
Nine Naquadah Ingots, for storage.
Found only on the Abyss planet, in the stone and sand of the sea bed. Drops Abyssal Pearls.
Right-click to crush it: 10 minutes of water breathing, night vision and dolphin's grace - made for exploring the Abyss.
Found only on the Skylands planet, in the stone of the floating islands. Drops Aether Crystals.
A light, pink crystal that seems to want to float. The key to the Aether Stabilizer Module.
A glowing mushroom that grows only on the Mycelia planet. In a Bio-Digester one Sporecap makes 2,000 mB of methane - ten times ordinary biomass.
Found only in the Crystal Depths, in stone, calcite, tuff and dripstone. Needs a diamond pickaxe. Drops Resonance Crystals.
A humming blue crystal. Makes the Mk II Speed and Energy upgrades and the Naquadah Installer.
A pink flower that grows only on Eden. Four of them make the Regeneration Module for the Quantum Suit.
Found only on the Karoo, in stone and terracotta. Drops Sunstone.
A glowing orange stone from the Karoo that burns like 40 coal - 64,000 ticks in a Coal Generator or furnace.
Found only in the Redwood, in stone. Drops Amber.
Hardened resin from the Redwood. Makes the Resistance Module for the Quantum Suit.
A gnarled root that grows only in the Murk. Makes the Antidote Module for the Quantum Suit.
Found only on Titan, deep in its mountains. Needs a diamond pickaxe. Drops Gravitite.
A heavy violet crystal from Titan. Makes the Haste Module for the Quantum Suit.
Found only on Wraith, in soul sand, soul soil and netherrack. Drops Soul Crystals.
A cold blue crystal from Wraith. Makes the Fire Immunity Module for the Quantum Suit.
Found only in Umbra, in deepslate and stone. Needs a diamond pickaxe. Drops Umbral Shards.
A shard of solid darkness from Umbra. Makes the Stealth Module for the Quantum Suit.
Found only in the Void Reach, in end stone. Needs a diamond pickaxe. Drops Void Shards.
A shard of the void. Eight around an Eye of Ender make a Void Pearl.
An ender pearl that comes back: throw it as often as you like, with a 3 second wait between throws.
